# Real model browser fixture

`obama-portrait.jpg` is the [2009 official portrait of Barack Obama](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Official_portrait_of_Barack_Obama.jpg), photographed by Pete Souza. It is licensed under [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). The fixture is used unmodified for local face detection testing. It is a photographic portrait, not an ID card.
